rule: Complete and freeze one package before beginning the next.

steps.name: Commercial Contract and Source-of-Truth Freeze
steps.outcome: Freeze definition versus instance ownership, Price versions, Order snapshots, Payment facts, Entitlement policies, operations, events and canonical errors.

steps.name: Payment Provider Abstraction
steps.outcome: Define provider-neutral adapter, normalized event, idempotency and Stripe mapping without changing current Book behaviour.

steps.name: Generic Commercial Persistence
steps.outcome: Add immutable operational Product/Offer/Price snapshots, Order, Payment and provider-reference storage in a new additive migration.

steps.name: Entitlement and Activation Service
steps.outcome: Create one Entitlement write owner with separate Book, Journey and future service activation policies; retain all Journey gates.

steps.name: Refund, Credit, Receipt and Settlement Ledgers
steps.outcome: Add append-only commercial adjustments, provider reconciliation and product-neutral receipt projection.

steps.name: Book Commerce Reconciliation and Cutover
steps.outcome: Bridge immutable 0004 identities, backfill idempotently, compare facts, then cut over without duplicate writes.

steps.name: Checkout and Consumer Projections
steps.outcome: Route Book checkout/webhook through canonical services; keep professional and membership surfaces disabled until separately approved.

steps.name: Commercial Runtime Gate
steps.outcome: Prove security, privacy, replay, refunds, multi-provider readiness, migration reconciliation and provider-independent Journey behaviour.
